analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 중이나 여전히 40선 하회. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세이나 여전히 음수 구간. 거래량 위축으로 추세 전환 동력 부족. 5일 연속 음수 변동률 기록으로 매수 진입은 신중.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive days. RSI is attempting to exit oversold but remains below 40. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. Lack of momentum for trend reversal due to subdued volume. Cautious entry due to 5 consecutive days of negative price change.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,435,000) vs SMA5 ($1,548,400)/SMA20 ($1,725,950)/SMA50 ($2,124,760) — below short/mid-term trends
· Position relative to SMA100 ($1,713,371)/SMA200 ($1,203,063) — potential shift to weak mid/long-term trend
· 52-week position (40.4%) — uptrend from historical low, deepening decline from high
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.7→39.3) — attempting to exit oversold but still weak
· MACD histogram trajectory (-43209.8822→-10299.6712) — improving but still in negative territory, weak convergence continues
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $1,288,913) — approaching lower band, band width is wide at 50.64%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,246,000) — support based on 20-day low
· Swing resistance (1,995,000) — below Pivot R1 ($2,078,000)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — No Higher Low, No Lower High, sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.49x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in movement
· Current phase diagnosis — Accumulation phase, buy entry requires RSI recovery above 45 and confirmation with volume
analysis.patternNote: 5일 연속 음수 변동률 기록으로 매수 진입은 신중해야 하는 구간. RSI 과매도 탈출 시도와 MACD 히스토그램 개선이 긍정적이나 거래량 부재로 추세 전환 동력 부족.
analysis.patternNoteEn: A phase requiring caution for buy entry due to 5 consecutive days of negative price change. While RSI's attempt to exit oversold and MACD histogram improvement are positive, the lack of volume hinders trend reversal momentum.
